paths.three: src/core/ is renderer-free: it must not import three.js.

patterns.message: src/core/ is renderer-free: it must not import three.js.

deniedGlobals.window: src/core/ runs in Node: no window.
deniedGlobals.document: src/core/ runs in Node: no document.
deniedGlobals.performance: src/core/ never reads the clock: take dt as a parameter.
deniedGlobals.Date: src/core/ never reads the clock: take dt as a parameter.
deniedGlobals.crypto: src/core/ uses the seeded Rng, never crypto.
deniedGlobals.structuredClone: src/core/ copies with spreads; structuredClone is a host API.
deniedGlobals.Intl: src/core/ formats nothing; Intl depends on the host locale.
deniedGlobals.setTimeout: src/core/ has no timers: take dt as a parameter.
deniedGlobals.setInterval: src/core/ has no timers: take dt as a parameter.
deniedGlobals.localStorage: src/core/ takes a storage interface as a parameter (records.ts).
deniedGlobals.navigator: src/core/ runs in Node: no navigator.
deniedGlobals.console: src/core/ returns events; it does not log.
